title: Warmly Spiced Turkish Vegetable Dolma
description: A floral and chewy Turkish dish featuring shoyu-koji, roast, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, served in a dolma form, perfect for a monsoon evening. This recipe combines the warmth of Turkish spices with the comfort of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the rice, shoyu-koji, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and mix well.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat, and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper to the skillet, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice mixture, roasted vegetables, turkish spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Stuff each dolma with the rice and vegetable mixture, and place them in a large baking dish.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the dolma, and cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake the dolma for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the dolma warm, garnished with fresh herbs and a dollop of yogurt if desired.
